schema.text: How wide is the space for walking?

options.text: Only one person can just about pass
One person can pass, but not a stroller or wheelchair
A stroller or wheelchair can pass, but people cannot pass each other
Two people can pass each other
Very wide, with plenty of room to move

en.#How wide is the space for walking?: How wide is the space for walking?
en.#Only one person can just about pass: Only one person can just about pass
en.#One person can pass, but not a stroller: One person can pass, but not a stroller or wheelchair
en.#A stroller or wheelchair can pass, but: A stroller or wheelchair can pass, but people cannot pass each other
en.#Two people can pass each other: Two people can pass each other
en.#Very wide, with plenty of room to move: Very wide, with plenty of room to move

it.#How wide is the space for walking?: Quanto è largo lo spazio per camminare?
it.#Only one person can just about pass: Passa a fatica una sola persona
it.#One person can pass, but not a stroller: Passa una persona, ma non un passeggino o una sedia a rotelle
it.#A stroller or wheelchair can pass, but: Passano un passeggino o una sedia a rotelle, ma non ci si incrocia
it.#Two people can pass each other: Due persone si incrociano senza problemi
it.#Very wide, with plenty of room to move: Molto ampio, con molto spazio per muoversi

fr.#How wide is the space for walking?: Quelle est la largeur de l'espace pour marcher ?
fr.#Only one person can just about pass: Une seule personne passe tout juste
fr.#One person can pass, but not a stroller: Une personne passe, mais pas une poussette ni un fauteuil roulant
fr.#A stroller or wheelchair can pass, but: Une poussette ou un fauteuil roulant passe, mais on ne peut pas se croiser
fr.#Very wide, with plenty of room to move: Très large, avec beaucoup d’espace pour se déplacer

de.#How wide is the space for walking?: Wie breit ist der Bereich zum Gehen?
de.#Only one person can just about pass: Gerade einmal eine Person kommt durch
de.#One person can pass, but not a stroller: Eine Person kommt durch, aber kein Kinderwagen oder Rollstuhl
de.#A stroller or wheelchair can pass, but: Ein Kinderwagen oder Rollstuhl kommt durch, aber man kann einander nicht ausweichen

tr.#Only one person can just about pass: Ancak tek bir kişi zorlukla geçebiliyor
tr.#One person can pass, but not a stroller: Bir kişi geçebiliyor, ama bebek arabası veya tekerlekli sandalye geçemiyor
tr.#A stroller or wheelchair can pass, but: Bebek arabası veya tekerlekli sandalye geçebiliyor, ama karşılaşan kişiler birbirinin yanından geçemiyor
tr.#Very wide, with plenty of room to move: Çok geniş, hareket etmek için bol alan var

fa.#Only one person can just about pass: فقط یک نفر به‌زحمت عبور می‌کند
fa.#One person can pass, but not a stroller: یک نفر عبور می‌کند، اما کالسکه یا ویلچر نه
fa.#A stroller or wheelchair can pass, but: کالسکه یا ویلچر عبور می‌کند، اما دو نفر نمی‌توانند از کنار هم رد شوند
fa.#Two people can pass each other: دو نفر می‌توانند از کنار هم عبور کنند
fa.#Very wide, with plenty of room to move: بسیار پهن، با فضای فراوان برای حرکت

hu.#One person can pass, but not a stroller: Egy ember elfér, de babakocsi vagy kerekesszék nem
hu.#A stroller or wheelchair can pass, but: Babakocsi vagy kerekesszék elfér, de kikerülni nem lehet egymást
hu.#Two people can pass each other: Két ember el tud haladni egymás mellett
hu.#Very wide, with plenty of room to move: Nagyon széles, sok hely van a mozgáshoz

ar.#One person can pass, but not a stroller: يمر شخص واحد، لكن لا تمر عربة أطفال أو كرسي متحرك
ar.#A stroller or wheelchair can pass, but: تمر عربة أطفال أو كرسي متحرك، لكن لا يمكن للأشخاص تجاوز بعضهم
ar.#Two people can pass each other: يمكن لشخصين أن يمرا بجانب بعضهما
ar.#Very wide, with plenty of room to move: واسع جدًا، مع مساحة كبيرة للحركة
